finalText:
All 4 test pass now.

Root cause: `processOrder.js` acquire connection direct (skip pool.js's `withConnection` safe wrapper), release call after `run()` — no try/finally. Bad order throw, release line never run, connection stuck in `inUse` forever. Worker log match exact: pool climb 2→5/5 over 2am window, then exhaust, jobs die, worker fatal-exit.

Fix: wrap release in `finally`. One-line pattern change, same as `handleRequest` already use.
